page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance based on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

Acceleration is delivered via a single integrated NVIDIA P4 GPU featuring 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of an entry-level NVIDIA P4 GPU provides a budget-friendly entry point for hardware-accelerated workloads without the high cost overhead of larger, modern GPU architectures. This configuration is suited for workloads such as low-latency video transcoding, inference with smaller machine learning models, basic computer vision tasks, and remote graphics rendering.
